title: NIST WebBook: Indian red oxide is Fe2O3, molecular weight 159.688 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Indian red oxide as Fe2O3, molecular weight 159.688 amu, CAS 1309-37-1.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Indian red oxide, CAS Registry Number 1309-37-1, lists molecular formula Fe2O3 and molecular weight 159.688 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 159.8546189 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/2Fe.3O. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
